messages.subject: Re: Combining scatter plot, predictions and facets...
parts:
Hi:

You just need to add a geom_line() layer to the original graphic p1.

ggplot(mydf, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
geom_point(aes(color = factor(subj))) +
labs(color = "Subject") +
geom_line(aes(y = ypred), color = "red", size = 1) +
facet_wrap( ~ z, nrow = 1) +
theme(panel.margin = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"))

I added a couple of lines to improve readability.

Dennis

On Fri, Apr 5, 2013 at 2:16 PM, Benilton Carvalho
<benilton...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi everyone,
>
> I was wondering if you guys could help me out with the grammar to combine a
> scatter plot, predictions and facets...
>
> A toy example is shown below, where I use the standard plots to do what I
> want:
>
> set.seed(1)
> N <- 100
> x <- runif(N)
> ypred <- 1+2*sin(10*x)
> y <- ypred+rnorm(N)
> z <- sample(letters[1:4], N, rep=TRUE)
> mydf <- data.frame(subj=sample(10, N, rep=T),
> x=x, y=y, ypred=ypred, z=z,
> stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
> mydf <- mydf[order(mydf$x),]
> rm(N, x, y, ypred, z)
>
> availZ <- with(mydf, sort(unique(z)))
> par(mfrow=c(1, length(availZ)))
> for (zi in availZ){
> tmp <- subset(mydf, z==zi)
> with(tmp, plot(x, y, main=zi, col=subj))
> with(tmp, lines(x, ypred, col=2, lwd=2))
> }
>
> With ggplot2, I'm able to do scatter + faceting and predictions + faceting
> (independently)... But I'm unable to combine both...
>
> library(ggplot2)
> p1 <- ggplot(mydf, aes(x, y)) + geom_point(aes(colour=factor(subj))) +
> facet_grid(. ~ z)
> p1
> p2 <- ggplot(mydf, aes(x, ypred)) + geom_line() + facet_grid(. ~ z)
> p2
>
> Could you please point me to the right direction?
>
> Thanks a lot,
> benilton
